trained: from scratch (random init), train_vdd.py --folds full --epochs 16 --steps_ep 1000 --bs 96 --far_boost 2; data = rr_seg (VDR_RRFIX) + render_vdr shards (seeds 9.1M-10M), depth slot only

input.name: depth
input.meaning: obs['depth'] exactly as delivered (normalised [0,1], metric = 0.5 + 29.5 d)

post: vdd_post.fires(heat, mask, depth[...,0], pos=state[0:3], rpy=state[3:6], thr, fov_deg) -> fires with x, y, top; 3x3 NMS, <= 4 per frame
fov: fov_est.estimate_joint over post-take-off frames (checkpoints 20/40/80 frames = 2/4/8 s; nominal 90 before the first); |err| median 0.08 deg, p90 0.17 deg on 100 val flights
trigger_rule: fires from >= 2 distinct evaluations within 2 m among the last 5 evaluations; trigger xy = mean of the cluster fires, top = MEDIAN of the cluster fires' tops
classes: trained on upright victims only; low-profile victims (chars 27/29) were ignored in the loss, so low-profile recall is low (it is not a low-profile detector)
